//: The config `next build` uses, and the only difference is that it leaves
Two tests deliberately import from outside web/: theme.test.ts reads
design/tokens.json to prove the dark palette in the stylesheet matches the
one in the token file, and share-script.test.ts reads scripts/share.mjs.
Both are the right thing to do - a constant copied into a second file is a
constant that goes stale, and these catch exactly that.
But the Docker image only copies web/, so those imports do not resolve
there and the production build failed on files that are not shipped. The
answer is to typecheck the application for the build and the whole tree
for `npm run typecheck`, rather than to weaken either one.
